name: What happens if I want to make changes after construction has started?
description: Changes are handled via written change orders detailing cost and timeline adjustments before revised construction takes place.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I want to make changes after construction has started?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mid-project design modifications are managed through formal change orders that document the specific scope adjustments, price impacts, and schedule effects before work proceeds. A practical tradeoff of changing floor plans or utility layouts after framing or mechanical rough-ins begin is that work may pause while revised calculations are verified or re-inspected. Addressing core structural preferences during early conceptual drafting keeps your project on schedule and avoids costly rework.
